protocol.title: A Digital Microfluidic Method for in Situ Formation of Porous Polymer Monoliths with Application to Solid-Phase Extraction
protocol.platform: Digital microfluidics (DMF) with in situ UV-polymerized porous polymer monolith (PPM) discs on EWOD electrode array
analytes: Fluorescamine-labeled angiotensin IV (10 uM in 0.1% FA; SPE efficiency validation)
Angiotensin II (1 uM in 100 mM NaCl; desalting)
Angiotensin II (1 uM in 0.05% w/v Pluronic F68; surfactant removal)
protocol.objective: In situ formation of C12 porous polymer monolith discs on a DMF device by UV-initiated photopolymerization, and application to on-chip solid-phase extraction (DMF-SPE) for preparative sample cleanup, desalting, surfactant removal, and preconcentration

small_actuation_electrodes.purpose: Elution solvent and monomer casting solution

device.bottom_plate: Patterned chromium electrodes on glass; Parylene-C 7 um + Teflon-AF 50 nm coating
device.fabrication: University of Toronto ECTI cleanroom; photolithography + chromium etching; Parylene-C by vapour deposition; Teflon-AF spin-coated at 1000 rpm 30 s, post-baked 160 C 10 min

C12_casting_solution.porogen_composition: 4:1:1 acetonitrile / 95% ethanol / 5 mM phosphate buffer pH 6.8

SPE_solvents.equilibration: 0.5% v/v formic acid in deionized water
SPE_solvents.wash: 0.5% v/v formic acid in deionized water
SPE_solvents.elution_fluorescein: 500 mM sodium borate in deionized water, pH 9.0

model_analytes.fluorescein: 5 uM in 0.5% v/v aqueous formic acid (process optimization)
model_analytes.angiotensin_IV_labeled: 10 uM fluorescamine-labeled angiotensin IV in 0.1% FA (SPE efficiency)
model_analytes.angiotensin_II_NaCl: 1 uM Ang II in 100 mM NaCl (desalting validation)
model_analytes.angiotensin_II_pluronic: 1 uM Ang II in 0.05% w/v Pluronic F68 (surfactant removal validation)

fluorescamine_labeling.angiotensin_IV_stock: 10 mM in 10 mM borate buffer pH 9, 10 uL
fluorescamine_labeling.incubation: >=2 h; diluted 10x with 0.1% FA before analysis

reagents.deionized_water: 18 MOhm cm at 25 C; filtered 0.2 um nylon; sonicated 5 min

PPM_characterization.surface_area_method: N2 adsorption BET (Autosorb-1, Quantachrome); outgassed 50 C 4 h; relative pressure 0.05-0.1 mbar

on_chip_disc.morphology: Skin-like outer layer; popcorn-like porous interior

dummy_substrate_disc.purpose: BET surface area measurement (on-chip discs too small for instrument sensitivity)

PPM_characterization.passive_dispensing_note: When droplet driven onto PPM disc, <10% of droplet volume remains on monolith; >90% continues moving. PPM not covalently bound to surface; removable/replaceable with tweezers.

steps.name: In situ PPM disc formation
steps.operation: dispense + translate (mix abstraction) + UV polymerization (heat abstraction)
steps.bioscript_abstraction: heat at 25c for 5m (no UV primitive in BioScript; isothermal hold models exposure interval)
steps.mix_note: Second MonomersC12 dispense required as BioScript mix operand for translation step; same reagent, no chemical change

steps.name: PPM activation
steps.notes: Conditions hydrophobic C12 stationary phase for reversed-phase SPE

steps.name: Sample loading
steps.analyte: Fluorescamine-labeled angiotensin IV, 10 uM in 0.1% FA

incubation_optimization.result: <20% fluorescence remains in droplet at 2 min
incubation_optimization.conclusion: 2 min selected; no significant difference vs 4 min

steps.name: PPM washing
steps.notes: Removes unbound matrix components while retaining analyte on C12 stationary phase

steps.name: Analyte elution
steps.detection: speExtractionDetection module; fluorescence plate reader (ex 390/em 460 nm for peptide; ex 480/em 520 nm for fluorescein)

steps.name: Preparative DMF-SPE: Desalting
steps.sample: Ang II 1 uM in 100 mM NaCl
steps.problem_without_SPE: 100 mM NaCl suppresses nanoESI signal; [M+H]+ at m/z 1047 absent
steps.result_after_SPE: Strong [M+H]+ signal at m/z 1047 (Ang II MW 1046)
steps.procedure: Same 4-step DMF-SPE as Protocol 2; 2 min loading; 2 elution droplets
steps.fresh_disc_note: FIX #2: disc1 consumed by Protocol 2; disc2 formed independently before this protocol
steps.detection: massSpecDetection module; off-chip nanoESI-MS (LTQ Finnigan, 1.7-2.0 kV, 0.5 uL/min, 200 C capillary)

steps.name: Preparative DMF-SPE: Surfactant Removal
steps.sample: Ang II 1 uM in 0.05% w/v Pluronic F68
steps.context: Pluronic F68 is standard DMF additive to prevent protein/peptide adsorption to Teflon-AF device surfaces, but is a strong nanoESI ion suppressor
steps.problem_without_SPE: 0.05% Pluronic F68 suppresses nanoESI signal; [M+H]+ at m/z 1047 absent
steps.procedure: Same 4-step DMF-SPE as Protocol 2; 2 min loading; 2 elution droplets
steps.fresh_disc_note: FIX #2: disc2 consumed by Protocol 3a; disc3 formed independently before this protocol
steps.detection: massSpecDetection module; off-chip nanoESI-MS (LTQ Finnigan, same conditions as desalting)

extraction_efficiency.conclusion: No significant difference; DMF-SPE (C12) comparable to commercial C18 ZipTips

concentration_factor.method: 12 uL sample on large-electrode device; elute in 1 uL

comparison_to_flat_surface_DMF_SPE.advantage_1: PPM 3D structure -> larger surface area than flat Teflon-AF surface of equal footprint -> higher analyte loading capacity
comparison_to_flat_surface_DMF_SPE.advantage_2: Eluate delivered to any device location (not permanently bound to a spot)
comparison_to_flat_surface_DMF_SPE.advantage_3: PPMs support wide variety of chemical functional groups (C12, C18, ion-exchange etc.); flat surface limited to Teflon-AF chemistry

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: PPM disc1 formation + Protocol 2 standard DMF-SPE

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(speSignal); PPM disc2 formation + Protocol 3a desalting

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(desaltSignal); PPM disc3 formation + Protocol 3b surfactant removal

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 10 basic blocks (BB1-BB10), 3 if/else gates, 12 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: BioScript supports s and m only; all durations expressed accordingly

fix_1_heat_is_void.description: heat in lilott8/BioScript is a void operation; result cannot be aliased. centredDroplet / disc2 / disc3 used directly after heat without assignment.
fix_1_heat_is_void.fix: Removed ppmDisc = centredDroplet alias; all three disc variables used directly post-heat

fix_2_disc_consumption.description: Each SPE protocol consumes its PPM disc through sequential mix operations. Protocols 3a and 3b each form an independent fresh disc before their SPE steps.

bioscript_compiler_notes.mix_two_operand_constraint: BioScript mix requires exactly two operands. PPM translation step (no second reagent physically) uses a second dispense of MonomersC12 as required operand; same reagent, no chemical change.
